items.title: Earnings live updates: Marriott stock falls as Middle East drags, Trump brothers-backed American Bitcoin swings to loss
items.summary: Earnings continue to be the market's engine, and a series of results this week from Palantir, SpaceX, and AMD are set to rev up stocks again.

items.title: Tyson Foods expects steeper losses in beef as third-quarter volumes slide
items.summary: The US meat giant has downgraded its forecast for the year’s operating income in beef to a loss of $650m on the top side.

items.title: Tyson Foods Cuts Profit Outlook, Asks “Where’s the Beef?”
items.summary: Cattle now cost more than the steaks made from them, and Tyson’s chicken business is the only thing keeping the company’s numbers from looking a lot worse

items.title: Tyson Foods Misses Third-Quarter Expectations and Cuts Full-Year Outlook
items.summary: Tyson Foods Inc. (NYSE:TSN) reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results on Monday that fell short of Wall Street forecasts, while lowering its full-year earnings outlook as ongoing challenges in its beef business continued to weigh on performance.

items.title: Tyson Foods cuts fiscal 2026 profit forecast on beef losses
items.summary: The meatpacker now expects a beef operating loss of up to $650 million for fiscal 2026, up from a prior forecast of $500 million

items.title: Tyson Foods (TSN) Lags Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Tyson (TSN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -3.88% and -1.92%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Tyson shares slip as sales miss estimates and volumes fall
items.summary: Shares in Tyson Foods Inc (NYSE:TSN) fell 3% ahead of the opening bell in New York after the meat processor reported sales that came in below Wall Street forecasts and a sharper-than-expected drop in the volume of product it shifted. items.title: Rising Beef Costs Pressure Tyson’s Bottom Line
items.summary: A shortage of cattle in the U.S. has been driving up costs for meatpackers like Tyson and JBS in recent years, leading to steep financial losses.
